description: A held server is started with the rest (runtime.zig `.need` without its held check)
old: Started(x) == IF x = "idle" THEN "starting" ELSE x
new: Started(x) == IF x \in {"idle", "waiting"} THEN "starting" ELSE x

description: A reload never starts the server it approved or added back (reloadHost without startHostServers)
old: IF s \in Stale THEN Started(Initial(decision, s)) ELSE st[cur][s]
new: IF s \in Stale THEN Initial(decision, s) ELSE st[cur][s]

description: A status refresh keeps the line it had
Quitting signals only running servers, not one a reload let go of that still stops
A removed server is loaded as an idle one
A server added back stays down
old: IF s \in Stale THEN Started(Initial(decision, s)) ELSE st[cur][s]
new: IF s \in Stale THEN IF decision[s] = "ok" THEN "absent" ELSE Started(Initial(decision, s)) ELSE st[cur][s]

description: A server whose host let go of it never exits until fx quits
old:
/\ <<h, s>> \in stopping
    /\ stopping' = stopping \ {<<h, s>>}
    /\ refreshed' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<decision, cur, alive, retired, leases, st, procs, termed
new:
/\ <<h, s>> \in stopping /\ quit
    /\ stopping' = stopping \ {<<h, s>>}
    /\ refreshed' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<decision, cur, alive, retired, leases, st, procs, termed

description: A server added back starts while the process its removal let go of still stops
A reload stops every running server, as a new host did
old: /\ LET gone == {p \in procs : p[1] = cur /\ p[2] \in Stale}

description: A change to the config files stops the server it touches at once, before the host loads it
old: /\ UNCHANGED <<cur, alive, retired, leases, st, procs, stopping, termed, framed, quit, shown, heldAt, loaded>>
new:
/\ LET gone == {<<cur, s>>} \cap procs IN procs' = procs \ gone /\ stopping' = stopping \cup gone
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cur, alive, retired, leases, st, termed, framed, quit, shown, heldAt, loaded>>

description: No check ever loads a change to the config files (refreshHost never reloads)
